simple_purpose: An observation and review capability: look at sanctuary posture, classify it, and suggest next work without executing that work. It describes, verifies, and reports. It does not autonomously intervene.
implementation_state_public_wording: Written observer law plus a local read-only dashboard prototype. Not a public monitoring service.
demonstrably_working: Written observer law: suggest only; do not execute the queue.
A local read-only dashboard prototype exists for operators.
Observer output is a status report, not a control plane.
non_public_or_unproven: Not automatic repair, merge, or deploy.
Not a live public telemetry feed.
Informational signals are not system failure.
Working local UI is not a production operations centre.
Does not expose private task-queue contents.
core_relationship: Observation and review used with Z-Sanctuary Core.
next_evidence_gate: Keep QUALIFIED visible. No queue contents, no local IPs, no iframe. Publication and Twin insert remain unauthorized.

public_safe_evidence_references.title: Cycle Observe system law
public_safe_evidence_references.supports: The observer must not execute queued tasks.
public_safe_evidence_references.does_not_support: Public SaaS monitoring or autonomous repair.
